title: Story premise ENT060: The Finite Spring Finale
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (mechanical puzzles). Hook: The machine works forever. Until now. Takeaway/theme: Show the input that keeps a mechanism moving.
description: A maker wants a toy theater to run forever on one wound spring, but the scene slows after each cycle. A cutaway shows the finite winding unwinding; the maker adds a visible audience hand crank and relabels the show HELP KEEP IT GOING, turning failure into participation.
